_comment: Acceptance-environment test data sourced from https://maviance.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SCG/pages/5161287683 . Spec terminology: cashout = collection (money OUT of customer wallet), cashin = disbursement (money INTO recipient wallet). Copy this file to smoke-test.json and fill in baseUrl, publicKey, secretKey. Set any block to null (or remove it) to skip the corresponding scenario.

cashout._comment: Collection — money flows OUT of customer wallet. Source row 20: CMMTNMOMO Cash-Out / Depot, serviceId 20053, MSISDN 677389120.

bill._comment: SEARCHABLE_BILL. Source row 6: ENEO postpaid contract 203157530. Other options: row 5 CAMWATER (990007 / 010178181220101), row 7 CMDGI (202302 / 43011666543), row 8 CMDOUANES (202303 / CMDP32023GEN017240I).

topup._comment: TOPUP airtime. Source row 12: CMMTN serviceId 20051, MSISDN 677389120. Other options: row 13 CMORANGE (20062 / 697707102), row 9 CMCamtel (20101 / 242349577).

_voucher_comment: Acceptance lists only one VOUCHER-type service and the page does not name its serviceId. After running once, find the VOUCHER service in the smoke-test's 'Service catalog' output (line: '- VOUCHER: N') by inspecting client.masterdata().services() entries with type=VOUCHER, then replace the null above with { "serviceId": <that id> }.

product._comment: PRODUCT. Source row 1: CanalPlus Canal+ decoder serviceId 90006. Other options: row 2 CMStarTimes (20021), row 3 NGDSTV (202301), row 4 CMEASYTV (91006).

subscription._comment: SUBSCRIPTION. Source row 23: CMSABC SABC Subscription serviceId 5000. Try sample 0000000101 first; if 'no subscriptions for…' fall back to alt sample 00000108, or to row 24 (serviceId 10041, ref 357-1029517-8 — merchant code not in the Confluence page so check services() output for it).

cashin._comment: Disbursement — money flows INTO recipient wallet. Source row 19: CMMTNMOMO Cash-In / Retrait, serviceId 20052, MSISDN 677389120 (note: 677389120 is server-blocked on acceptance with respCode 40305 — use CMORANGEMOMO 50052 / 699999999 instead, verified working). Other options: row 17 CMORANGEOM Cash-In (30052 / 697707102), row 21 CMYOOMEEMONEY Cashin (100237 / 242254751). Set 'collect' to true (with customerPhonenumber, customerEmailaddress, serviceNumber) to follow the quote with a real POST /v2/collectstd — this MOVES MONEY on the configured environment. Omit 'collect' or set it to false to stay quote-only.

verify._comment: Pre-payment serviceNumber validation. Source row 6: ENEO postpaid contract 203157530 (verifiable contract).

validate._comment: Account validation via GET /v2/validate — returns a CustomerAccount {status, name, destination}. Status: UNKNOWN | VALIDATED (syntax only) | VERIFIED (cross-checked with provider). Sample: MTN MoMo MSISDN 677389120 against the cashout service 20053 (row 20). Swap destination/serviceId for the account you want to validate.
